The name of the topic to query.
This topic must be a SOW topic, a view, a queue, or a conflated topic.
There is no default for this parameter.
This parameter supports regular expressions.

The message type of the topic to query.
There is no default for this parameter

Set the filter to apply.
If a Filter is present, only messages matching that filter will be
returned by the query.

Sets the name of the variable within which AMPS will store the first
message returned.

If no records are found, AMPS stores the DefaultData in the variable
specified by CaptureData.

An OrderBy expression to use to order the results returned by the
query.
For example, to order in descending order of the /date field in the
messages, you would provide an OrderBy option of /date DESC.
